title_says: Asks how ancient humans managed relationships, promising an explanation of past social practices.
thumbnail_says: ONLY ONE? appears above a handholding pair and a flexing alternative; heart eyes and a frown depict romantic tension.
shared_information: Both identify relationships among people in an ancient or prehistoric context.
title_only_information: The title explicitly promises an explanation of how relationships were managed, rather than only a romantic dilemma.
thumbnail_only_information: The illustration introduces attraction to an alternative partner and asks about exclusivity using ONLY ONE?.
unanswered_question: Were ancient relationships exclusive, and what social practices governed partner choice?
package_promise: An accessible historical explanation of relationship practices, illustrated through an exclusivity dilemma.
viewer_expectation: A history explainer that goes beyond the cartoon triangle to discuss relationship arrangements and their context.
strongest_element: The short exclusivity question adds a concrete dilemma without repeating the title's broader explanatory wording.
weakest_element: The generic rivalry cartoon provides little evidence of the specific historical practices the title promises to explain.
improvement: HYPOTHESIS: add one sourced historical-practice cue and test whether it improves topic specificity while preserving the readable two-word question.

title_says: Promises Cape Verde's entire history in seven minutes and calls it a strange Atlantic paradise the viewer knows nothing about.
thumbnail_says: CAPE VERDE and 1460–2026 label an illustrated waterfront town, mountains, palms and sea.
shared_information: The destination name and broad historical-overview subject appear in both title and image.
title_only_information: Seven-minute duration, Atlantic location, strangeness and the claim of viewer unfamiliarity are supplied by the title.
thumbnail_only_information: A specific date span and a colorful coastal-town setting give the overview a visual identity.
unanswered_question: What makes Cape Verde's historical development unusual beyond the appealing scenery?
package_promise: A short historical overview of Cape Verde, framed as an unfamiliar and unusual Atlantic destination.
viewer_expectation: A chronological explainer with reasons this island setting has a distinctive history; visible dates suggest broad temporal coverage.
strongest_element: The destination name and coastal scene provide immediate topic recognition at mobile size.
weakest_element: The image reinforces a generic overview without showing the unusual historical premise claimed in the title.
improvement: HYPOTHESIS: show one documented turning point as the visual hook and shorten repeated title framing while retaining the country name and short-duration signal.
